mapper.select: SELECT ap.suggestion_no, s.product_name, s.proposed_min_interest_rate, s.proposed_max_interest_rate, ap.rate_no, ap.terms_no, ap.description_no, ap.condition_no FROM TB_APPROVED_SUGGESTION ap JOIN TB_PRODUCTS_SUGGESTION s ON ap.suggestion_no = s.suggestion_no WHERE s.manager_employee_no = #{manager_employee_no} AND s.approval_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY ap.suggestion_no DESC

SELECT s.suggestion_no,
s.employee_no, e.employee_name, e.job_title, e.dept_no,
s.manager_employee_no, m.employee_name AS manager_name, m.job_title AS manager_job_title, m.dept_no AS manager_dept_no,
s.product_name, s.suggestion_content, s.proposed_min_interest_rate, s.proposed_max_interest_rate, s.approval_status, s.reject_reason, s.suggested_at, s.processed_at,
ap.rate_no, ap.terms_no, ap.description_no, ap.condition_no
FROM TB_PRODUCTS_SUGGESTION s JOIN TB_employee e -- 작성자 ON s.employee_no = e.employee_no JOIN TB_employee m -- 승인 책임자 ON s.manager_employee_no = m.employee_no JOIN TB_APPROVED_SUGGESTION ap -- 중간테이블 ON s.suggestion_no = ap.suggestion_no WHERE s.suggestion_no = #{suggestion_no} AND s.approval_status = 'APPROVED'
SELECT * FROM TB_APPROVED_SUGGESTION A JOIN TB_PRODUCTS_SUGGESTION B ON A.suggestion_no = B.suggestion_no
